# Vendored report assets

Served at `/report_vendor/` so the report page makes no third-party requests.
Fetched 2026-10-29 from jsdelivr, byte-identical to the CDN copies the page
used before:

- `d3.v4.min.js`: d3 4.13.0 (BSD-3-Clause), was https://d3js.org/d3.v4.min.js
- `d3-scale-chromatic.v1.min.js`: d3-scale-chromatic 1.5.0 (BSD-3-Clause),
  was https://d3js.org/d3-scale-chromatic.v1.min.js
- `font-awesome/`: Font Awesome 4.4.0 (CSS MIT, fonts SIL OFL 1.1), was
  https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/font-awesome/4.4.0/
